common_out_of_sample.rule: the quotes no available model was fitted to: the intersection of every model's out-of-sample set

models.description: eSSVI global surface (theta, psi, rho per expiry); Gatheral-Jacquier butterfly conditions, monotone theta and wing slopes, and slice ordering certified on a 4,001-point k-grid; inverse half-spread weights

raw SVI per expiry; Durrleman g(k) >= 0 rows on 481 points of k in [-3, 2] plus cutting planes until svi.butterfly_certificate passes, and Lee wing bounds; no calendar constraint between slices; inverse half-spread weights

raw SVI per expiry with Durrleman g(k) >= 0 rows on 481 points of k in [-3, 2] and Lee wing bounds, and calendar ordering w_(i-1) <= w_i <= w_(i+1); a slice is accepted only when svi.butterfly_certificate and svi.ordering_certificate pass (cutting planes until they do); block coordinate descent from the eSSVI fit; inverse half-spread weights

butterfly.certificate: svi.butterfly_certificate: Durrleman g on CERT_GRID (k in [-3, 2] at 1e-4 spacing; tails uniform in 1/k out to k = 2,000 and -3,000), every local minimum refined by golden-section search, and the |k| -> inf limit 1/4 - (b(1 +- rho))^2/16

ordering.certificate: svi.ordering_certificate: w_{i+1} - w_i >= -1e-10 on CERT_GRID (k in [-3, 2] at 1e-4 spacing; tails uniform in 1/k out to k = 2,000 and -3,000) with every local minimum refined; wing slopes b(1 +- rho) non-decreasing to 1e-10; on a wing whose slopes tie, the asymptotic intercept ordered to 1e-10
ordering.check_grid: essvi.CHECK_GRID (4,001 points on k in [-3, 2] plus |k| = 10, 30)

notes: Every model is scored on the same quote universe (the calibrator's cleaned quotes, 8,627) with the same metrics and dense-grid checks. Each model's out_of_sample set is the quotes it was not fitted to, so its size differs by model (essvi 4,301, svi 4,301, svi_cal 4,301); metrics.common_out_of_sample scores every model on the same 4,301 quotes, those no model was fitted to.

Surfaces are fitted to alternate strikes, so their out-of-sample quotes are the strikes in between (an interpolation test); Heston is not scored on this session: no joint SPX/VIX Heston fit is stored for 2026-10-30 (data_store/calibrations/joint_cal_2026-10-30.pkl): the calibration was rejected by its gate or not run on this session. The surface, the arbitrage screen and the VIX replication are built from the session's book and do not depend on it.

svi_cal is the arbitrage-free surface on this session: every slice passes svi.butterfly_certificate (Durrleman g >= 0 on a 1e-4 grid over k in [-3, 2] and a 1/k grid out to |k| = 2,000-3,000, each local minimum refined, and the |k| -> inf limit; minimum g 2.80e-09) and every consecutive pair passes svi.ordering_certificate (total variance ordered to 1e-10 on the same grids, wing slopes and tied-wing intercepts included; minimum w_(i+1) - w_i -9.5e-11). Numerical certificates, not closed-form; fields surface.json surfaces.svi_cal.butterfly_certificate / calendar_ordering. svi has no calendar constraint and its calendar violations are counted in dense_grid.

Quotes are Cboe's delayed SPX book (data_store/options/cboe/spx_2026-10-30_084019Z.parquet) as of 2026-10-30T23:49:50Z (closing): every model is scored against the exchange's own bid and ask at one instant.
